subproblems.title: Level preservation of the degree-(1,1) cup cocycle
subproblems.statement: Let k be a field, G a group, Ω=AlgebraicClosure ℚ, r:G→Autℚ(Ω) a group homomorphism, and A,B,N k-representations of G. Let E₀⊆Ω be a rational intermediate field finite-dimensional over ℚ. Assume that r(s) fixing E₀ implies s·b=b for every b∈B. Let φ:A→ₗ[k]B→ₗ[k]N satisfy φ(s·a,s·b)=s·φ(a,b) for every s,a,b. Let f:G→A and g:G→B be one-cocycles, so f(st)=s·f(t)+f(s) and g(st)=s·g(t)+g(s). Assume each is level: there are finite-dimensional rational intermediate fields Ff,Fg such that f(sh)=f(s) whenever r(h) fixes Ff and g(th)=g(t) whenever r(h) fixes Fg. Then e(s,t)=φ(f(s),s·g(t)) belongs to levelCocycles₂ r N: it is a two-cocycle and there is a finite-dimensional rational intermediate field F such that e(sh,tℓ)=e(s,t) whenever r(h),r(ℓ) fix F.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (E₀ : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), FiniteDimensional ℚ E₀ → (∀ s : G, r s ∈ E₀.fixingSubgroup → ∀ b : B, B.ρ s b = b) → ∀ φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N, (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∀ (f : groupCohomology.cocycles₁ A) (g : groupCohomology.cocycles₁ B), groupCohomology.IsLevelConstant₁ r (⇑f) → groupCohomology.IsLevelConstant₁ r (⇑g) → groupCohomology.cupCochain φ (⇑f) (⇑g) ∈ groupCohomology.levelCocycles₂ r N
subproblems.natural_proof:
1. Fix all the stated data and define e(s,t)=φ(f(s),s·g(t)). This is exactly cupCochain φ f g. The two-cocycle differential is d₂e(s,t,u)=s·e(t,u)−e(st,u)+e(s,tu)−e(s,t).
2. Equivariance, the representation identity s·(t·b)=(st)·b, and the two one-cocycle identities give d₂e(s,t,u)=φ(s·f(t),(st)·g(u))−φ(s·f(t)+f(s),(st)·g(u))+φ(f(s),(st)·g(u)+s·g(t))−φ(f(s),s·g(t)). Expanding the second and third terms by bilinearity cancels φ(s·f(t),(st)·g(u)), φ(f(s),(st)·g(u)), and φ(f(s),s·g(t)), each with its negative. Thus d₂e=0 and e∈cocycles₂ N.
3. Choose witness fields Ff,Fg for the two level hypotheses. Set F=(E₀⊔Ff)⊔Fg. Applying IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup twice proves that F is finite-dimensional over ℚ. The inclusions E₀≤F, Ff≤F, and Fg≤F imply that every automorphism fixing F fixes each constituent field.
4. Let s,t,h,ℓ∈G with r(h),r(ℓ) fixing F. The witness conditions give f(sh)=f(s) and g(tℓ)=g(t). Since r(h) fixes E₀, the action hypothesis gives h·g(t)=g(t). Consequently e(sh,tℓ)=φ(f(sh),(sh)·g(tℓ))=φ(f(s),s·(h·g(t)))=φ(f(s),s·g(t))=e(s,t). Hence F witnesses IsLevelConstant₂ r e.
5. By definition, levelCocycles₂ r N is the intersection of cocycles₂ N with the submodule of level two-cochains. Steps 2 and 4 give both memberships, proving the conclusion.
proof_key_steps: Expand the cup differential using equivariance and the one-cocycle identities, then cancel by bilinearity.
Form the finite compositum (E₀⊔Ff)⊔Fg and restrict its fixing condition to all three fields.
Use the level identities and trivial action on B to prove two-variable level constancy.
Combine cocycle membership and level constancy to obtain membership in levelCocycles₂.

subproblems.title: A left one-coboundary cups to a level two-boundary
subproblems.statement: Let k be a field, G a group, Ω=AlgebraicClosure ℚ, r:G→Autℚ(Ω) a group homomorphism, and A,B,N k-representations of G. Let φ:A→ₗ[k]B→ₗ[k]N be equivariant: φ(s·a,s·b)=s·φ(a,b) for all s,a,b. Fix a∈A and a one-cocycle g:G→B satisfying g(st)=s·g(t)+g(s). Assume g is level, meaning that some finite-dimensional rational intermediate field F⊆Ω satisfies g(th)=g(t) whenever r(h) fixes F. Define d₀a(s)=s·a−a. Then cupCochain φ (d₀a) g belongs to levelCoboundaries₂ r N, the image of the level one-cochains under d₁v(s,t)=s·v(t)−v(st)+v(s).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N), (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∀ (a : A) (g : groupCohomology.cocycles₁ B), groupCohomology.IsLevelConstant₁ r (⇑g) → groupCohomology.cupCochain φ (fun s : G => A.ρ s a - a) (⇑g) ∈ groupCohomology.levelCoboundaries₂ r N
subproblems.natural_proof:
1. Fix the stated data. Choose a finite-dimensional rational intermediate field F witnessing the level property of g, and define v:G→N by v(t)=φ(a,g(t)).
2. If r(h) fixes F, then v(th)=φ(a,g(th))=φ(a,g(t))=v(t). Thus the same F witnesses IsLevelConstant₁ r v, so v is a member of levelCochains₁ r N.
3. For arbitrary s,t∈G, equivariance gives s·φ(a,g(t))=φ(s·a,s·g(t)), and the one-cocycle identity gives g(st)=s·g(t)+g(s). Therefore d₁v(s,t)=φ(s·a,s·g(t))−φ(a,s·g(t)+g(s))+φ(a,g(s))=φ(s·a,s·g(t))−φ(a,s·g(t))=φ(s·a−a,s·g(t)), using linearity in the second argument to cancel φ(a,g(s)) and linearity in the first argument for the last equality.
4. The final expression is cupCochain φ (fun s↦s·a−a) g evaluated at (s,t). Equality at every pair gives equality of the two cochains. Since levelCoboundaries₂ r N is precisely the image of levelCochains₁ r N under (d₁₂ N).hom, the level cochain v is a preimage of the required cup cochain. This proves its membership in levelCoboundaries₂ r N.
proof_key_steps: Choose v(t)=φ(a,g(t)) as the boundary primitive.
Use the level field of g to prove that v is level.
Compute d₁v=cupCochain φ (d₀a) g using equivariance and the cocycle identity.
Use the defining image description of levelCoboundaries₂.

subproblems.title: A right one-coboundary cups to a level two-boundary
subproblems.statement: Let k be a field, G a group, Ω=AlgebraicClosure ℚ, r:G→Autℚ(Ω) a group homomorphism, and A,B,N k-representations of G. Let E₀⊆Ω be a rational intermediate field finite-dimensional over ℚ such that r(s) fixing E₀ implies s·b=b for every b∈B. Let φ:A→ₗ[k]B→ₗ[k]N satisfy φ(s·a,s·b)=s·φ(a,b) for all s,a,b. Fix a one-cocycle f:G→A satisfying f(st)=s·f(t)+f(s), and fix b∈B. Assume f is level: some finite-dimensional rational intermediate field Ff⊆Ω satisfies f(sh)=f(s) whenever r(h) fixes Ff. Define d₀b(t)=t·b−b. Then cupCochain φ f (d₀b) belongs to levelCoboundaries₂ r N, the image of the level one-cochains under d₁v(s,t)=s·v(t)−v(st)+v(s).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (E₀ : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), FiniteDimensional ℚ E₀ → (∀ s : G, r s ∈ E₀.fixingSubgroup → ∀ b : B, B.ρ s b = b) → ∀ φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N, (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∀ (f : groupCohomology.cocycles₁ A) (b : B), groupCohomology.IsLevelConstant₁ r (⇑f) → groupCohomology.cupCochain φ (⇑f) (fun t : G => B.ρ t b - b) ∈ groupCohomology.levelCoboundaries₂ r N
subproblems.natural_proof:
1. Fix the stated data and choose a finite-dimensional witness field Ff for f. Define u:G→N by u(s)=φ(f(s),s·b), and put F=E₀⊔Ff. The theorem IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup proves that F is finite-dimensional over ℚ.
2. If r(h) fixes F, it fixes both E₀ and Ff. Thus f(sh)=f(s) and h·b=b. By the representation law, u(sh)=φ(f(sh),(sh)·b)=φ(f(s),s·(h·b))=φ(f(s),s·b)=u(s). Hence u is level with witness F. The cochain v=−u is level with the same witness, since v(sh)=−u(sh)=−u(s)=v(s).
3. For any s,t∈G, equivariance and the representation law give s·u(t)=φ(s·f(t),(st)·b). Using f(st)=s·f(t)+f(s) yields d₁u(s,t)=φ(s·f(t),(st)·b)−φ(s·f(t)+f(s),(st)·b)+φ(f(s),s·b)=−φ(f(s),(st)·b)+φ(f(s),s·b).
4. Since (st)·b=s·(t·b) and the action of s and the map φ(f(s),−) are linear, the last expression equals −φ(f(s),s·(t·b−b)). This is the negative of cupCochain φ f (fun t↦t·b−b) at (s,t). Linearity of the differential now gives d₁v=d₁(−u)=−d₁u=cupCochain φ f (fun t↦t·b−b).
5. The cochain v is level by Step 2 and has the required differential by Step 4. By the defining image description of levelCoboundaries₂ r N, this proves that the specified cup cochain belongs to levelCoboundaries₂ r N.
proof_key_steps: Define u(s)=φ(f(s),s·b) and refine the level field to E₀⊔Ff.
Use trivial action on b and the level property of f to show u and −u are level.
Take the level primitive −u and apply the image definition of levelCoboundaries₂.
